name: Dhërmi in a day
description_md:
Dhermi in a day is a one day city sightseeing walk between the city's main sights in AL. The route spans 11.9 km of walking between stops and takes about 5.5 hours for the full day, visit time at each stop included.

The day is anchored in Dhermi and features 4 sightseeing stops.
